attributes.board_name: Arizona State Veterinary Medical Examining Board

rules.accepted_credit_types: Board-approved CE: taught by or under a veterinary technician school or veterinary college; sponsored by AzVMA or AAVSB; RACE-approved; Board-approved state or national veterinary technician associations or academies; or pre-approved by the Board
rules.new_licensee_rule: Certificate first issued in an even-numbered year: 5 credit hours before the first renewal.
rules.alternatives: Written waiver request to the Board by December 10 before the certificate expires.
rules.notes: Certified veterinary technician certificates expire Dec 31 of even years. Max 2.5 h combined for presenting, tapes/CDs and journal reading; internet interactive programs count hour for hour. Rule text read is Supp. 13-3.
